statement: No retrieved work realizes the aspirational distinction claimed for the idea. The additional legal-IR literature conceptualises relevance dimensions but reports no clause-level, version-selection retrieval evaluation for amended statutes, and the legal-AI reliability literature measures hallucination in end systems rather than temporal version selection. All retrieved version-aware legal retrieval still uses hard validity filtering, so the distinction remains unrealised by any published mechanism other than the one already published (TempRALM) and is correctly described as aspirational for the proposed soft elapsed-time term.

evidence.quote: We discuss a conceptual framework on relevance within legal information retrieval, based on a typology of relevance dimensions used within general information retrieval science, but tailored to the specific features of legal information
each hallucinate between 17% and 33% of the time
